fixes.explanation: Resent is a different word, and the angel never says it. He says, “…now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me.” The angel gives his reason: Abraham did not hold back his only son. Nothing in the verse says Abraham was bitter, so I'm not going to put that on him.
